comparisons.peer_topic: Other Consumer portfolio composition and charge-offs
comparisons.peer_summary: Other consumer primarily consists of deposit overdraft balances. Net charge-offs decreased $185 million to $295 million in 2024 compared to 2023, primarily driven by lower overdraft losses from fraud activity.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America disclose performance metrics for their 'other consumer' or unsecured loan segments, specifically highlighting net charge-offs. JPMorgan reported an increase in net charge-offs for its 'auto and other' portfolio to $445 million due to declining used vehicle valuations, whereas Bank of America reported a decrease in net charge-offs for its 'Other consumer' portfolio (primarily overdraft balances) to $295 million, driven by lower fraud losses. Both disclosures address the trend in unsecured/alternative consumer credit loss experience.
